about.title: About
about.body: All-Science Sims is a client-side collection of original interactive simulations and virtual labs across 14 subjects: physics, chemistry, biology, earth & space, computer science, data science, social science, mathematics, finance & economics, engineering, music & acoustics, climate & sustainability, psychology, and cognitive science. Every sim is hand-built in vanilla JavaScript, runs entirely in your browser, works in English or Bahasa Indonesia, and can be shared as a deep link or embedded in any web page. Free for students, teachers, self-learners, and anyone curious about science; commercial use needs a license.
